nom: Olay Retinol Night Cream for Women

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including one prone to closed comedones and mild acne, report the cream is lightweight and creates a matte-ish finish rather than adding shine, though one says she still needs more time to judge the full effect.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: several with dry or dry-and-sensitive skin report good hydration and no irritation, while one says it made no visible difference on the driest patches of her face and suggests pairing it with another product if skin is very dry.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers, including some prone to cystic acne, report no irritation and appreciate the fragrance-free formula, but two reviewers — one of whom says she does not normally have sensitive skin — describe a severe burning, itching reaction requiring discontinuation or a prescription cream.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin that shifts between dry and oily reports the cream works well at night and recommends it for anyone needing extra hydration on drier areas.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to 70s report smoother skin and fewer visible fine lines and wrinkles with regular use, generally after several weeks to a few months.

concerns.aging: Reviewers across their 40s to 70s report visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles, smoother texture, and firmer-looking skin, typically noticing initial change within one to two weeks and fuller results after several weeks to a few months of consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the cream as strongly moisturizing and non-greasy, with effects lasting through the night; one reviewer notes retinol can dry skin out at first but says skin adjusts over time.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report a range of reactions: some see no redness at all, one notices mild next-morning redness she interprets as a sign the retinol is working, and two describe a severe burning or "retinol burn" reaction on the face or neck; a rosacea sufferer reports her skin looking substantially better after adding this cream to her routine.
concerns.barrier: Most reviewers, including several who identify as sensitive or prone to cystic acne, report no irritation from the fragrance-free formula, but a few describe painful burning, itching, or stinging reactions — including near the eyes — severe enough in one case to require a prescription treatment.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report mixed results on dark spots and discoloration: one with light hyperpigmentation is still hoping to see fading, another saw zero improvement in her hyperpigmentation after two weeks, while a reviewer with rosacea and post-lesion-removal scarring reports her scars substantially faded and a melasma sufferer reports softer, brighter, firmer-looking skin.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers prone to breakouts, including one with cystic acne and one with closed comedones, report the cream does not clog pores or cause new breakouts, with one saying it has never given her a problem despite skin that otherwise breaks out easily.
concerns.oiliness: A reviewer with very oily skin reports the cream leaves a more matte, drier finish on her skin rather than added shine, while another with oily, comedone-prone skin reports satisfaction but says she needs more time to judge the full effect on oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Small amount needed, jar lasts a long time
Some jars arrive apparently opened or previously used
Rich, thick texture suited to nighttime use
Silky finish that doesn't transfer to pillow or clothing
Heavy glass jar can be slippery on wet surfaces

extraits.titre: Painful burning itching face and neck after only 3 uses
extraits.texte: I would not recommend this product to anyone but I’d you want to try it put it on a small spot somewhere unnoticeable for a few days first. I developed a horribly painful itching burning rash on my face and neck. I used the product 3 times and this picture was taken 4 days after I quit using it and 2 days after I started using a prescription cream from my doctor to treat the damage. It was a lot worse than this.

extraits.titre: Didn't work; not for near the eyes
extraits.texte: Thought I would try this for my hyperpigmentation. I used it for over 2 weeks and saw zero difference (I know it says 4 weeks, but surely I would see something when past the halfway point). The color of my hyperpigmentation was just as dark. Additionally, because the product photos showed improvement in the woman's eye-area wrinkles, I decided to put some Olay closer to the corners of my eyes after the first week. That was a HUGE MISTAKE. A day or two in, I put some sunscreen near my eyes (as normal) and OMG the stinging, burning pain! Two hours later, washed my face with my usual gentle cleanser and the pain returned. Disregard the product photos: this should not be used near your eyes. (Issue resolved when I discontinued use there). Now, this is a nice night cream: pleasant fragrance and does a good job moisturizing. A little goes a long way too: I definitely need to use less than my regular moisturizer because it's thick. So it's a good quantity for the price: it will last a long time. Oh, and if you have mid-century bathroom fixtures (sink edge, toilet back) this glass jar is definitely going to crash onto your floor. The bottom of the jar is slick and not compatible with gently sloping surfaces. Maybe Olay Retinol works for others, but it is not for me.

I have extremely dry, sensitive skin and I’m prone to cystic acne, so I patch test just about everything before it goes on my face. I also started introducing this slowly since it contains a higher amount of retinol, and I’m really glad I did because I absolutely love it. I only use it at night and wouldn’t recommend wearing it before sun exposure or on sunburned skin since retinol can make your skin more sensitive. I apply it after my milky toner, and it layers really well. The cream is thick and very moisturizing without feeling greasy or clogging my pores. It has no added fragrance, which is a huge plus for sensitive skin, and it’s done a great job keeping my skin hydrated. You also get a generous amount of product, so the jar lasts a long time. Overall, I think it’s a great value for the money. If you have dry, sensitive skin and are looking for a fragrance-free retinol moisturizer, this has been a great addition to my skincare routine. My only wish is that it would come with an applicator bc I don’t want to be sticking dirty or fully sterile hands into a product that I’ll be applying to my face. I ended up buying a skincare spatula to apply to keep fingers out of it.

To start this off, my skin type is oily，prone to closed comedones and some acne. This olay moisturizer claims to hydrate skin for 24 hours, visible improvements in fine lines wrinkles, smoothness, brightness, forming, dark spots, and pores. I was really excited when I found out that Olay had created a new retinol 24 line. Overall very satisfied with this product，But I need a longer time to feel the changes it brings to my skin!

So I generally have a combination skin that shifts between dry and oily. What I really love about this cream so far is that it's perfect for night time. It is on the heavier side when it comes to thickness but does apply to my skin well. I've been using it the last few weeks have have seen some of the deeper lines that use to be on my forehead look smaller and more filled in. I'd highly recommend this for individuals with dryer skin who need hydration.

I NEVER leave reviews, but I’m making an exception for this. I was wary of spending this much money on a moisturizer, but the reviews and the coupon got me to try it. I’m so glad I did! I was diagnosed with Rosacea in February, and was using a prescription ($500 ointment). I saw some improvement but not what I was hoping for. I started using this Regenerist Max, at night (in addition to my prescription in the morning) and in less than a week my skin looks substantially better. I also notice fewer lines, and my scars from having pre-cancerous lesions removed are substantially faded. I read where another reviewer had used this to treat a burn scar and, since I had a large burn on my forearm (2nd degree) that was fairly pronounced, I decided it was worth trying. In 48 hours it’s 90% healed! I plan to buy more regenerist products in the future because of these results

extraits.titre: It takes a while to see noticeable results, but it seems to help.
extraits.texte: I am 76 years old, and like most women try to prevent or remedy the signs of aging - especially on my face. Let's face, no facial cream is going to work miracles. Keeping your face moisturized, diet, and even heredity are all factors that affect your aging. In addition, the use of any facial cream is not going to show any improvement overnight. Prior to writing this review, I have used this facial cream for over 3 months before for I go to bed. I use a different cream for the daytime since this cream is heavier. So, what do I like about this facial cream? 1) Although it is thicker than my daytime cream, it absorbs well without having to rub it in. 2) It has little to no scent. 3) It seems to have reduced wrinkles I had a few months ago. I have added picture of my mother at 98 and also pictures of myself from a couple years ago and current. In choosing a facial cream, it is kind of a pig and a poke. Some work and some are a total waste of money and time. You just need to find one you are comfortable with and then give it at least 3 months or more to see any possible results. Personally, I like this as a night cream, and have seen some results. I do recommend this as a night cream, but you may not have the same results I have seen. As mentioned previously, diet and heredity are also factors. I hope this review was helpful for you.
